Lemma
[Characterization of the minimizing two-form] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0318 1. ch15:15.29\group Minimizing Harnack Tensor

For $\Rm >0$, \[ P_{abc}W_c+R_{abdc}U_{cd}=0 \quad \Longleftrightarrow \quad U_{ab}=S_{abij}P_{ijp}W_p. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply $S$ to the first equality and use $S\Rm =I$ on two-forms. The converse follows by applying $\Rm $ to the second equality.

□
